environment: macOS (Darwin 25.6), Python 3.14.7, Node v24.19.0, git 2.50.1; branches.py and push_guard.py run as subprocesses through the testkit cli-runner in scratch git repos (TZ=UTC unless set, scratch HOME)

cases.title: State name is sdlc/state- plus 14 UTC digits under far time zones
cases.given: A scratch git repo with no config, and TZ set to Pacific/Kiritimati, America/Adak, Etc/GMT+12, Etc/GMT-14 and unset
cases.when: branches.py name --repo <repo> --kind state runs once per TZ value
cases.then: Each run exits 0 with one JSON line, and the tail is the UTC time between the times taken before and after the call
cases.expected: sdlc/state-<%Y%m%d%H%M%S in UTC>, exit 0, empty stderr, no file change
cases.actual: All five runs printed sdlc/state-<14 digits> in UTC inside the window, exit 0, stderr empty, tree unchanged

evidence.title: scratch repo and cwd before and after
evidence.inline: every run: tree of cwd and --repo unchanged, git refs included (see "--- tree ... (unchanged)" lines in the transcript log)

cases.title: State name keeps its tail under custom formats and ignores extra flags

cases.title: Malformed --round and --part are refused or give an ASCII integer
cases.given: A scratch repo; values 1.5, 0x1, empty, " 1", 1_0, +1, -1, 00, Arabic-Indic digits, 5000 nines, and the integer-forms, unicode-digits and huge-integers corpus families
cases.when: name --kind verify runs with each value in --round and in --part
cases.then: Each run exits 2 with a JSON error naming the flag, or exits 0 with an ASCII branch of the template shape; never a traceback or a file change
cases.expected: exit 2 or an ASCII integer result
cases.actual: Non-integers (1.5, 0x1, empty) exit 2 naming the flag. argparse int() accepts whitespace, +, _, leading zeros, -1 and non-ASCII digits; the output is always ASCII. Negative values give sdlc/S-001-v-1-... (seed). Trees unchanged

cases.title: Hostile --profile and --id values never crash and never escape the format prefix
cases.given: A scratch repo; the traversal, control-chars, flag-like-values, unicode-whitespace, injection, format-strings, unicode-confusables and oversized corpus families
cases.when: name --kind verify runs with each value as --profile=<v> and as --id=<v>
cases.then: No traceback, empty stderr, one JSON line, exit 0 or 2, no file change; an accepted branch starts with sdlc/ and ends with -0
cases.expected: No crash, no branch outside the sdlc/ prefix
cases.actual: 188 values gave exit 0 and the rest exit 2; none crashed; every accepted branch starts with sdlc/. Some are ref-unsafe, for example sdlc/../..-v0-http-api-0 (seed)

cases.title: Custom branch formats wrap verify and attempt tails, --format wins, a bad format exits 2
cases.given: A scratch repo whose .sdlc/config.json sets branchFormat feature/PROJ-1-{name:lower}
cases.when: name runs for verify and attempt under the config, under --format x/{name}/y, Team/PROJ-1-{name:lower} and sdlc/{name}, under six invalid formats, and against an invalid config.json
cases.then: The format wraps the tail; {name:lower} lowercases the tail only; --format wins over config; an invalid format or config exits 2 with no branch
cases.expected: feature/PROJ-1-s-001-v0-http-api-0, feature/PROJ-1-s-001-attempt-1, x/S-001-v0-http-api-0/y, x/S-001-attempt-1/y, Team/PROJ-1-s-001-v0-http-api-0, sdlc/S-001-attempt-1; exit 2 for bad formats
cases.actual: All outputs matched. The six bad formats exit 2 with an error naming the format and no branch key. The invalid config exits 2 with "not valid JSON". Trees unchanged

cases.title: push_guard.py output equals the pins, and each pinned push site is in the source
cases.given: The slice tree at the verified commit
cases.when: python3 skills/sdlc/test/push_guard.py <tree> runs; the PINS object is read from push-guard.test.mjs; the push and pr list lines are read from state-write.py and next-action.py
cases.then: Every output key equals its pin. There are 11 direct sites, 6 network entries, 3 pushes and one forge site. The pushes sit in advance_run_branch, ensure_milestone_branch and prune_stale_milestone_branches. The two gh pr list reads sit in load_prs. The push targets are config.runBranch, sdlc/<milestone_id>, and branches that match ^sdlc/M-\d+$
cases.expected: Output equal to the pins; no push target is a verify name
cases.actual: All keys equal the pins. The three pushes and the two pr list reads are at the named functions. Targets: run (config.runBranch), want = f"sdlc/{milestone_id}", and a deletion of a branch that matches MILESTONE_BRANCH. A verify name does not match ^sdlc/M-\d+$. No target is built from a verify name

seeds.title: Negative --round, --part and --n are accepted
seeds.detail: argparse int() accepts -1, so name prints sdlc/S-001-v-1-http-api-0, sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api--1 and sdlc/S-001-attempt--1. The spec does not bound name inputs.

seeds.title: Integer parts accept whitespace, '+', '_' and non-ASCII digits
seeds.detail: ' 3', '+1', '1_000', '010', '٣' and '１２' are accepted and normalized to ASCII integers. Two inputs can give one branch name.

seeds.title: name returns ref-unsafe names for hostile --id and --profile values
seeds.detail: For example --id ../.. gives sdlc/../..-v0-http-api-0. The output is not passed through git check-ref-format. Every accepted name keeps the sdlc/ prefix.

seeds.title: Pinned pushes take their target from config and milestone data (seed S1)
seeds.detail: advance_run_branch pushes config.runBranch, and ensure_milestone_branch pushes sdlc/<milestone_id>. A runBranch or milestone id equal to a verify name would push it. The guard pins the call site, not the data.
